title: Preserving a recorded list under agreement
statement: Let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, and suppose a list $l$ of length $N$ records the values of $\mu$ at the consecutive indices starting at $a$, where $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$. If $\mu'$ agrees with $\mu$ at every index $b$ satisfying $a\le b<a+N$ and $b<\mathrm{top}$, then $l$ also records $\mu'$ on that segment, with the same length and bound.
hypotheses_covered: l records μ on the segment starting at a
μ' agrees with μ whenever a≤b<a+N and b<top
